description: This file implements RSA signature verification and related cryptographic utilities for a software component involved in remote device management (RDM). It includes functions for buffer dumping, ASCII-hex to binary conversions, signature file processing, manifest preparation, and the core signature verification logic utilizing OpenSSL. The file is specific to signature verification workflows, file handling, and cryptographic checks within the RDM framework.

methods.name: void dump_buffer(void * buffer,int buffer_size,char * name)
methods.description: Outputs the content of a buffer to stdout and to a binary file with timestamped name for debugging purposes.

methods.name: int asciihex_to_bin(const char * asciihex,size_t asciihex_length,unsigned char * bin,size_t * bin_length)
methods.description: Converts an ASCII Hex string to binary format. Useful for signature decoding.

methods.name: int bin_to_asciihex(const unsigned char * bin,size_t bin_length,char * asciihex,size_t * asciihex_length)
methods.description: Converts binary data to ASCII hex string. Used in signature verification.

methods.name: int prepare_sig_file(char * sig_file)
methods.description: Prepares the signature file by removing headers and moving the cleaned signature to the proper location.

methods.name: int prepare_app_manifest(char * etc_manifest_file,char * cache_manifest_file,char * padding_file,char * prefix)
methods.description: Adds a prefix to each line in a manifest file and appends a padding file path; prepares manifest for verification.

methods.name: int prepare_kms_pubkey()
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the public key used for signature verification, either via config or system call.

methods.name: int prepare_rdm_files_for_sign_verification(char * cache_dir,char * app_name)
methods.description: Prepares necessary files (signatures, manifests, padding) for signature verification process.

methods.name: int rdm_signature_verify(char * cache_dir,char * app_name,int prepare_files)
methods.description: High-level function to verify the signature of a package, including preparation, initializing cryptography, and invoking verification.

methods.name: int read_signature_file(const char * sig_file,unsigned char ** sig_buffer,int * sig_size)
methods.description: Reads an ASCII hex signature file and converts it to binary form.

methods.name: int manifest_file_size(const char * data_file,int * buffer_size)
methods.description: Calculates the size of a given manifest file.

methods.name: int rdm_openssl_file_hash_sha256(const char * data_file,size_t file_len,unsigned char * hash_buffer,int * buffer_len)
methods.description: Reads and hashes a data file using SHA-256.

methods.name: int rdm_openssl_file_hash_sha256_pkg_components(const char * data_file,size_t file_len,unsigned char * hash_buffer,int * buffer_len)
methods.description: Hashes a manifest including its package components for verification.

methods.name: int openssl_verify_signature(const unsigned char * hashval,int hashval_len,const char * sig_file,const char * vkey_file,char * reply_msg,int * reply_msg_len)
methods.description: Verifies a SHA-256 hash against an ASCII hex RSA signature using a public key.

methods.name: int rdm_openssl_rsa_file_signature_verify(const char * data_file,size_t file_len,const char * sig_file,const char * vkey_file,char * reply_msg,int * reply_msg_len)
methods.description: Performs the full RSA signature verification process over a data file and its signature.
